lineUnderGrid: Prices in US dollars and include any sales tax that applies. Cash Pass is software. It issues no card, holds no balance and moves no money.

free.name: Free
free.whoLine: For trying it with up to three cards.
inclusions: At checkout: which of your cards to use, and why, in one line
Up to 3 cards, entered by hand from the category reference, no bank connection
Unlimited manual rules: a shop, a chain or a category assigned to a card, and a rule always wins
Wallet deep links: one tap opens the right card in your phone's wallet
Category reference: the published earning categories and rates for the cards you hold, kept current
$0 today and every year. No card on file. Nothing to cancel.
free.stickySummary: Free. $0. Never bills. Nothing to cancel.
free.quizLine: Free. Three cards, by hand, for nothing.
free.toastAdded: Free is in your cart. $0, never bills.
free.leadParagraph: Add up to three cards by hand and write rules for the stores you use. Cash Pass names the card at checkout. No bank connection and nothing to cancel.

pass.name: Pass
pass.whoLine: For people who carry four cards or more.
pass.cancelLine: Cancel in two taps, any time. Your plan runs to the end of the paid year.
inclusions: Everything in Free
Unlimited cards
Read only card connection through a third party aggregator, a token rather than your password, so your last twelve months sort by merchant and category
Automatic rules proposed from your history, each one shown to you before it takes effect
Rotating category reminders before every quarter opens, and a nudge while a card is still unactivated
Cap tracking through the year: spend to date against every annual and quarterly cap, to the dollar
The annual fee ledger: each card's fee netted off what that card earned, card by card, with the year's true number at the bottom
Renews at $59 a year. Cancel in two taps, any time; the plan runs to the end of the paid year.
pass.renewalLine: Renews at $59 a year. Cancel in two taps, any time.
pass.stickySummary: Pass. $59 a year. Renews at $59 a year. Cancel in two taps, any time.
pass.quizLine: Pass keeps the light on all year.
pass.toastAdded: Pass is in your cart. $59 a year, tax included.
pass.leadParagraph: For four cards or more. Connect your cards read only and Pass suggests rules from your history, tracks every cap and reminds you before each rotating quarter. The ledger subtracts each annual fee from what that card earned.

family.name: Pass Family
family.whoLine: For a household of up to five people.
family.unitLine: Up to 5 people, unlimited cards each
family.cancelLine: Cancel in two taps, any time. Your plan runs to the end of the paid year.
inclusions: Everything in Pass, for up to 5 people, each with their own login and their own cards
One shared rule set: a rule written once applies to everyone in the house
Household earnings view: one total for the year, fees netted off
Per person breakdown: who earned what, on which card
Card details stay with the person who holds the card; the household sees totals, never transactions
Renews at $99 a year. Cancel in two taps, any time; the plan runs to the end of the paid year.
family.renewalLine: Renews at $99 a year. Cancel in two taps, any time.
family.stickySummary: Pass Family. $99 a year. Renews at $99 a year. Cancel in two taps, any time.
family.quizLine: Pass Family. One set of rules for up to five people.
family.toastAdded: Pass Family is in your cart. $99 a year, tax included.
family.leadParagraph: Up to five people, each with their own login and cards, share one set of rules. The household view shows the year's total after fees, with a line per person, and never anyone's transactions.
